title: A Surrogate Refused an Abortion and Fled to Texas. Now She Wants Custody of the Baby.
summary: A surrogate refused to have an abortion after the fetus was diagnosed with a serious heart problem. She fled to Texas and had the child. Now she wants a judge to give custody to her instead of the biological parents.
